title: Number Play: Parity, Magic Squares and Virahanka Numbers
seo_title: Number Play Class 7 Worksheet with Answers (Ganita Prakash Part 1, Chapter 6)
standard_code: Class 7, Ganita Prakash Part 1, Chapter 6: Number Play
standard_text: Parity of sums and expressions, magic squares, the Virahanka–Fibonacci numbers and digit puzzles (cryptarithms) (summary of NCERT Ganita Prakash Class 7)
meta_desc: Class 7 Number Play worksheet (Ganita Prakash Part 1, Chapter 6): odd and even, magic squares, Virahanka numbers and cryptarithms. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: 2n is always even; 2n + 1 is always odd
key_sub: In a 3 × 3 magic square, the centre is the magic sum ÷ 3.
body_html:
How it works

Parity: a sum is odd only if it has an odd number of odd terms. Every even number is 2n and every odd number is 2n + 1.

In a magic square every row, column and diagonal has the same sum. With 1 to 9 the magic sum is 45 ÷ 3 = 15 and the centre is 5.

The Virahanka numbers 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, … count rhythms of short and long beats; each is the sum of the two before.

Example

Is 37 + 54 + 19 odd or even?

Two odd numbers: 37 and 19

Answer: Even

Example

Magic square with 1 to 9: what is the magic sum?

1 + 2 + … + 9 = 45

45 ÷ 3

Answer: 15

Common mistakes

  • Thinking any sum of odd numbers is odd (two odds make an even).
  • Taking the magic sum as the total of all nine numbers.
  • Adding the wrong two terms in the Virahanka sequence.

faq.a: When it contains an odd number of odd numbers.
A square grid of numbers in which every row, column and diagonal adds up to the same number.
1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, … — the number of rhythms made from short and long beats, described by Virahanka about 1,300 years ago.

Without adding, is 44 + 18 + 91 + 28 odd or even?
items.e: There is 1 odd number, so the sum is odd.

items.q: If n is any whole number, is 2n − 1 odd or even?
items.e: 2n − 1 is one more than a multiple of 2 for every n: Odd.
